mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organization_invites i WHERE i.uuid = d.invitation_uuid AND i.organization_uuid = d.organization_uuid AND i.status = 'pending' AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.expires_at = d.expires_at AND i.expires_at > clock_timestamp())
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_admin_invite_deliveries d SET status = 'sending', updated_at = now() WHERE d.uuid = #{deliveryUUID} AND d.status IN ('pending', 'sending', 'failed') AND RETURNING d.uuid, d.organization_uuid, d.recipient, d.expires_at
UPDATE platform_admin_invite_deliveries SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE uuid = #{deliveryUUID} AND status = 'sending'
